title: Eligibility criterion annotation CSV row
description: All CSV cells are strings. Empty labels in an unannotated queue are missing labels, never negatives. Exact spans are zero-based Python Unicode code-point offsets with an exclusive end. One row per condition atom; repeat the complete context span and logical signature for compound criteria.

case_id.description: Local criterion or synthetic reference ID.

study_id.description: Registry study ID, or explicit SYNTHETIC-REFERENCE prefix. Never split one study across train/dev/test.

source.description: Registry source URL or explicit synthetic authoring provenance.

reviewer.description: Reviewer ID(s) and adjudicator ID; unassigned or not_expert_reviewed when applicable.

text.description: Immutable full source document for the offset coordinate system.

exact_span.description: Must equal text[int(span_start):int(span_end)]. Retain negation, visit, exceptions and list scope in this evidence span.

entity.description: Normalized field such as age, hba1c, type_2_diabetes; outside-model entities may be named explicitly. This is a semantic field label, not a minimal lexical mention boundary.

value.description: JSON object with value or lower/upper and endpoint inclusion flags; use true/false booleans for diagnosis constraints. Preserve null versus false.

unit.description: Canonical unit; source unit remains visible in exact_span. Empty for Boolean diagnoses.

negation.description: Lexical negation. Section exclusion scope is separately represented by NOT in logical_signature.

logical_signature.description: JSON rule forest with complete AND/OR/NOT tree. The empty string means unannotated; [] means reviewed unsupported/no executable representation.

executable.description: True means unambiguous and fully representable under the declared field/operator/unit model, not clinical eligibility. False requires an explicit reviewer rationale.

rationale.description: Scope/ambiguity decisions, unsupported parts, conversions and disagreements.
